justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/LazyInitializer.java` (176 lines): it has one state field (`object`), one sentinel (`NO_INIT`), one inner `Builder`, and only three behavior methods on the class itself (`get()`, `getTypedException()`, `isInitialized()`). The shared close/initializer plumbing is delegated to `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/AbstractConcurrentInitializer.java`, so `LazyInitializer` stays narrowly focused on lazy single-instance initialization. The tests in `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/LazyInitializerSimpleTest.java` and `LazyInitializerSupplierTest.java` also exercise only this focused behavior and builder wiring. This is a small, cohesive abstraction, not an insufficiently modularized class.
